<!DOCTYPE node PUBLIC "-//freedesktop//DTD D-BUS Object Introspection 1.0//EN"
                      "http://www.freedesktop.org/standards/dbus/1.0/introspect.dtd">
<!-- GDBus 2.88.0 -->
<node>
  <interface name="org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties">
    <method name="Get">
      <arg type="s" name="interface_name" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="s" name="property_name" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="v" name="value" direction="out"/>
    </method>
    <method name="GetAll">
      <arg type="s" name="interface_name" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="a{sv}" name="properties" direction="out"/>
    </method>
    <method name="Set">
      <arg type="s" name="interface_name" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="s" name="property_name" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="v" name="value" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <signal name="PropertiesChanged">
      <arg type="s" name="interface_name"/>
      <arg type="a{sv}" name="changed_properties"/>
      <arg type="as" name="invalidated_properties"/>
    </signal>
  </interface>
  <interface name="org.freedesktop.DBus.Introspectable">
    <method name="Introspect">
      <arg type="s" name="xml_data" direction="out"/>
    </method>
  </interface>
  <interface name="org.freedesktop.DBus.Peer">
    <method name="Ping"/>
    <method name="GetMachineId">
      <arg type="s" name="machine_uuid" direction="out"/>
    </method>
  </interface>
  <interface name="org.gnome.Mutter.RemoteDesktop.Session">
    <method name="Start"/>
    <method name="Stop"/>
    <method name="NotifyKeyboardKeycode">
      <arg type="u" name="keycode" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="b" name="state" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="NotifyKeyboardKeysym">
      <arg type="u" name="keysym" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="b" name="state" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="NotifyPointerButton">
      <arg type="i" name="button" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="b" name="state" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="NotifyPointerAxis">
      <arg type="d" name="dx" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="d" name="dy" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="u" name="flags" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="NotifyPointerAxisDiscrete">
      <arg type="u" name="axis" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="i" name="steps" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="NotifyPointerMotionRelative">
      <arg type="d" name="dx" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="d" name="dy" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="NotifyPointerMotionAbsolute">
      <arg type="s" name="stream" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="d" name="x" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="d" name="y" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="NotifyTouchDown">
      <arg type="s" name="stream" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="u" name="slot" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="d" name="x" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="d" name="y" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="NotifyTouchMotion">
      <arg type="s" name="stream" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="u" name="slot" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="d" name="x" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="d" name="y" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="NotifyTouchUp">
      <arg type="u" name="slot" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="EnableClipboard">
      <arg type="a{sv}" name="options" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="DisableClipboard"/>
    <method name="SetSelection">
      <arg type="a{sv}" name="options" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="SelectionWrite">
      <arg type="u" name="serial" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="h" name="fd" direction="out"/>
    </method>
    <method name="SelectionWriteDone">
      <arg type="u" name="serial" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="b" name="success" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="SelectionRead">
      <arg type="s" name="mime_type" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="h" name="fd" direction="out"/>
    </method>
    <method name="ConnectToEIS">
      <arg type="a{sv}" name="options" direction="in"/>
      <arg type="h" name="fd" direction="out"/>
    </method>
    <method name="SetKeymap">
      <arg type="a{sv}" name="options" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <method name="SetKeymapLayoutIndex">
      <arg type="u" name="index" direction="in"/>
    </method>
    <signal name="Closed"/>
    <signal name="SelectionOwnerChanged">
      <arg type="a{sv}" name="options"/>
    </signal>
    <signal name="SelectionTransfer">
      <arg type="s" name="mime_type"/>
      <arg type="u" name="serial"/>
    </signal>
    <property type="s" name="SessionId" access="read"/>
    <property type="b" name="CapsLockState" access="read">
      <annotation name="org.freedesktop.DBus.Deprecated" value="true"/>
    </property>
    <property type="b" name="NumLockState" access="read">
      <annotation name="org.freedesktop.DBus.Deprecated" value="true"/>
    </property>
    <property type="a{sv}" name="KeymapCapabilities" access="read"/>
    <property type="a{sv}" name="CurrentKeymap" access="read"/>
  </interface>
</node>
